review_notes: I read the whole file and grepped the neighbouring Sec13 files (Models2, Models3, Models4) for UT3.commutator_eq, UT3.central_ab and SylSU34_central_a. The only repeated pieces are small. Both UT3_Q and SylSU34_Q show that w.a = 0 and w.b = 0 make w commute with everything, using `ext <;> simp [...]; ring`. Both also finish with `rw [UT3.commutator_eq]; ext; simp [hza]; simp [hzb]; ...`. These are short routine computations, and the final coordinates differ. The UT3 case solves a linear equation over GF(4). The SylSU34 case needs the trace/tau machinery over GF(16). A shared lemma would save only a few lines and would need extra hypotheses to cover both cases. NabModel.of_equiv and the two model theorems are thin wrappers. I found no repeated nontrivial reasoning that justifies a refactor under this rubric.
